ev_0006.summary: Triangle with top horizontal side BC and bottom apex A. Pixel vertices: B=(79.4,48), C=(275.6,48), A=(178.1,221.0). A circle centered at A (radius 118.0) crosses AB at D=(119.8,118.4) and AC at E=(236.0,118.5); both are at distance 118 from A. Arc DE measured from A spans about 59 degrees (angles about -119.5 to -60.4 deg in image coordinates, passing over the top), so the arc between D and E is the minor arc. The full 360-degree circle_01 report is not confirmed: extract_visible_arc returned 72 samples but no circle or range summary, so whether the arc is drawn only between D and E is unverified. No right-angle marks were verified. Segment line_04 (183,231)-(179,249) lies below the apex, outside the triangle and off all sides, and is most likely a stub or noise.
